releaseNotes: Boundary-scan/DTC pre-drive scan no longer mislabels a mid-scan transport drop as unreachable-modules; retries once after reconnect stabilizes
Automatic reconnects no longer reset force-poll cooldowns, fixing repeated 3-4s re-probes of already-known-unsupported PIDs
Confirmed-unsupported PIDs now appear in the drive log unavailable_pids.ndjson
